all_facts.fact: Queen Sarah P-fly rules as the unchallenged sovereign of the Sacred Chain, the pulsating heart of Block Topia, where her decrees shape the destiny of The GKniftyHEADS and the broader Crypto Moonboys universe, anchoring decentralized power.

As the host of the Hard Fork Games, she presides over fierce blockchain battles in Block Topia, determining the elite HODL X Warriors, an event that stands as a crucible for rebellion and a defining ritual of strength in the metaverse.

Her influence extends beyond mere governance, embodying the spirit of street-art rebellion inspired by Sarah PU51FLY, merging real-world passion with digital authority to inspire warriors against centralized forces in every corner of Block Topia.

facts: The story revolves around two main factions: the All City Bulls and the Nomad Bears, also styled AllCity Bulls and, in GK’s latest brief, Nomad Bares. They embody the bulls and bears of the market in a world where crypto rules everyday life. The Bitcoin Kid Army shadows members of both factions 24/7 as undercover guards, never far away even when its protection cannot be seen.

Alfie “The Bitcoin KiD” Blaze leads the Bitcoin Kid Army and takes orders only from the GKniftyHEADS faction. GKniftyHEADS are the underworld good guys: the authority above the Bulls, the Bears and the remaining 37 GK factions that run their city. The Bitcoin Kid Army is the army for the crypto market, not a GK street faction or an extra place in the Forty. The structure is GKniftyHEADS + two main market factions + 37 other GK factions.

HODL Warriors are the underworld army formed from members of all GK factions. They are not a faction; members retain their own faction identities. This collective wartime army is distinct from the HODL X Warriors of Block Topia. Every HODL Warrior aspires to become a HODL X Warrior; aspiration does not itself award the title, erase faction identity or complete the Hard Fork trials.

Queen Sarah P-fly rules Block Topia with her Crypto Moongirls army and the HODL X Warriors within its order. The Bitcoin X Kids are the city’s engineered generation. Some escape and join Alfie’s Bitcoin Kid Army outside; the inside-born generation, the wider outside Bitcoin Kids community and enlisted Army service remain different categories.
